```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(summarytools)
library(dtplyr)  # For efficient data.table-backed dplyr operations
library(kableExtra)  # For enhanced table formatting
library(broom)  # For tidying model outputs

# Load the dataset (ensure NSDUH_2023.Rdata is in your working directory)
load("NSDUH_2023.Rdata")

# Create a copy of the dataset
d <- data
```

```{r functions}
# Function to create composite drug use variables
create_composite <- function(data, vars, name) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(name) := case_when(
        if_any(all_of(vars), ~ . == 1) ~ 1,
        if_all(all_of(vars), ~ . == 0) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}
```

```{r data_preparation}
# Select relevant variables (using dtplyr for efficiency)
s <- d %>% 
  lazy_dt() %>% 
  select(
    # Core IDs & Weights
    QUESTID2, VEREP, VESTR_C, ANALWT2_C,
    
    # Demographics / Confounders
    AGE3, CATAG2, IRSEX, NEWRACE2, EDUSCHGRD2, POVERTY3,
    
    # Drug Variables (Exposures)
    CIGFLAG, CGRFLAG, PIPFLAG, SMKLSSFLAG, NICVAPFLAG, ALCFLAG, CBDHMPFLAG, 
    MRJFLAG, COCFLAG, CRKFLAG, HERFLAG, HALLUCFLAG, INHALFLAG, METHAMFLAG, 
    PNRANYFLAG, TRQANYFLAG, STMANYFLAG, SEDANYFLAG,
    
    # Outcome Variables
    YMDELT, YMDEAUD5YR, YMIUD5YANY, YMSUD5YANY, 
    
    # Other Covariates
    AVGGRADE, PARLMTSN
  ) %>% 
  as_tibble()

# Define drug variable lists
all_drug_vars <- c("CIGFLAG", "CGRFLAG", "PIPFLAG", "SMKLSSFLAG", "NICVAPFLAG", 
                   "ALCFLAG", "CBDHMPFLAG", "MRJFLAG", "COCFLAG", "CRKFLAG", 
                   "HERFLAG", "HALLUCFLAG", "INHALFLAG", "METHAMFLAG", 
                   "PNRANYFLAG", "TRQANYFLAG", "STMANYFLAG", "SEDANYFLAG")

soft_drug_vars <- c("CIGFLAG", "CGRFLAG", "PIPFLAG", "SMKLSSFLAG", 
                    "NICVAPFLAG", "ALCFLAG", "CBDHMPFLAG", "MRJFLAG")

hard_drug_vars <- c("COCFLAG", "CRKFLAG", "HERFLAG", "HALLUCFLAG", 
                    "INHALFLAG", "METHAMFLAG", "PNRANYFLAG", "TRQANYFLAG", 
                    "STMANYFLAG", "SEDANYFLAG")

# Create composite variables using the function
s_clean <- s %>%
  create_composite(all_drug_vars, "any_drug_ever_used") %>%
  create_composite(soft_drug_vars, "any_soft_drug_ever_used") %>%
  create_composite(hard_drug_vars, "any_hard_drug_ever_used")

# Preview the composite variables
glimpse(s_clean %>% select(any_drug_ever_used, any_soft_drug_ever_used, any_hard_drug_ever_used))

# Define confounders
confounder_vars <- c("AGE3", "IRSEX", "NEWRACE2", "EDUSCHGRD2", "POVERTY3", "AVGGRADE", "PARLMTSN")

# Prepare analytic dataset for youth
youth_analytic <- s_clean %>%
  # Filter for youth (ages 12-17)
  filter(AGE3 %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  
  # Recode variables
  mutate(
    # Recode outcome: Major Depressive Episode (MDE)
    YMDELT_factor = factor(YMDELT, 
                           levels = c(1, 2), 
                           labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    
    # Recode demographics
    AGE3 = factor(AGE3, 
                  levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                  labels = c("12-13", "14-15", "16-17")),
    
    IRSEX = factor(IRSEX, 
                   levels = c(1, 2), 
                   labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    
    any_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_drug_ever_used, 
                                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                                       labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used")),
    
    # New composites for soft and hard
    any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_soft_drug_ever_used, 
                                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                                            labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used")),
    
    any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_hard_drug_ever_used, 
                                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                                            labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used"))
  ) %>%
  
  # List-wise deletion: remove NAs in outcome, exposures, and confounders
  drop_na(YMDELT_factor, any_drug_ever_used_factor, any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor, 
          any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor, all_of(confounder_vars))

# Report dropped rows
original_rows <- nrow(s_clean %>% filter(AGE3 %in% c(1, 2, 3)))
final_rows <- nrow(youth_analytic)
cat("Dropped", original_rows - final_rows, "rows due to NAs (out of", original_rows, "youth rows).\n")

# Check sample sizes and distributions (unweighted)
cat("--- Unweighted Age Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(youth_analytic$AGE3))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Any Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(youth_analytic$any_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Soft Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(youth_analytic$any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Hard Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(youth_analytic$any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Depression Outcome Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(youth_analytic$YMDELT_factor))
```

```{r survey_design}
# Create survey design object
svy_analytic <- svydesign(
  id      = ~VEREP,
  strata  = ~VESTR_C,
  weights = ~ANALWT2_C,
  data    = youth_analytic,
  nest    = TRUE
)

# Print survey design summary
print(svy_analytic)
```

```{r table1}
# Define variable labels
var_labels <- list(
  AGE3 ~ "Age Group",
  IRSEX ~ "Sex",
  NEWRACE2 ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
  EDUSCHGRD2 ~ "Education",
  POVERTY3 ~ "Poverty Level",
  AVGGRADE ~ "Average Grades",
  PARLMTSN ~ "Parental Monitoring",
  any_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Any Drug Use (Ever)",
  any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Soft Drug Use (Ever)",
  any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Hard Drug Use (Ever)"
)

# Generate weighted Table 1 stratified by outcome
table1 <- svy_analytic %>%
  tbl_svysummary(
    by = YMDELT_factor,
    include = c(AGE3, IRSEX, NEWRACE2, EDUSCHGRD2, POVERTY3, AVGGRADE, 
                PARLMTSN, any_drug_ever_used_factor, any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor, 
                any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor),
    label = var_labels,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)")
  ) %>%
  add_overall(
    col_label = "**Overall (N = {N_unweighted})**",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)")
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels()

# Display the table with kableExtra for better formatting
table1 %>%
  as_kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# Export table to CSV
write.csv(table1$table_body, "table1_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r confounder_tests}
# Define variables for testing
outcome_var <- "YMDELT_factor"
all_exposures <- c("any_drug_ever_used_factor", "any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor", "any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor")
confounders_to_test <- c("AGE3", "IRSEX", "NEWRACE2", "EDUSCHGRD2", 
                         "POVERTY3", "AVGGRADE", "PARLMTSN")

# Function to safely run svychisq and handle errors
safe_svychisq <- function(formula, design) {
  tryCatch({
    svychisq(formula, design = design)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error in svychisq for ", deparse(formula), ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Test confounders vs. outcome
cat("--- Confounder vs. Outcome (Depression) Tests ---\n")
conf_outcome_tests <- lapply(confounders_to_test, function(conf) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("~", conf, "+", outcome_var))
  safe_svychisq(formula, svy_analytic)
})
names(conf_outcome_tests) <- confounders_to_test
print(conf_outcome_tests)

# Test confounders vs. each exposure
for (exp in all_exposures) {
  cat("\n\n--- Confounder vs.", exp, "Tests ---\n")
  conf_exposure_tests <- lapply(confounders_to_test, function(conf) {
    formula <- as.formula(paste("~", conf, "+", exp))
    safe_svychisq(formula, svy_analytic)
  })
  names(conf_exposure_tests) <- confounders_to_test
  print(conf_exposure_tests)
}
```

```{r logistic_regression}
# Function to fit and summarize weighted logistic regression
fit_logistic <- function(exposure, confounders, design) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", exposure, "+", paste(confounders, collapse = " + ")))
  model <- svyglm(formula, design = design, family = quasibinomial())
  tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)  # Odds ratios with CIs
}

# Fit models for each exposure
models <- list()
for (exp in all_exposures) {
  cat("\n\n--- Logistic Regression for", exp, "vs. MDE ---\n")
  models[[exp]] <- fit_logistic(exp, confounders_to_test, svy_analytic)
  print(models[[exp]])
}

# Export model results
for (exp in names(models)) {
  write.csv(models[[exp]], paste0("logistic_", exp, "_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r interpretation}
# Interpretation Section
cat("## Results Interpretation\n\n")
cat("### Table 1:\n")
cat("- This table shows weighted distributions of characteristics stratified by MDE status.\n")
cat("- Significant p-values indicate differences between groups (e.g., higher drug use in MDE cases).\n\n")

cat("### Confounder Tests:\n")
cat("- Chi-square tests assess associations between confounders and outcome/exposures.\n")
cat("- Significant results suggest potential confounding (adjust for these in models).\n\n")

cat("### Logistic Regression:\n")
cat("- Models estimate adjusted odds ratios (OR) for MDE by drug use type.\n")
cat("- OR > 1 indicates increased MDE risk; 95% CI not crossing 1 means statistical significance.\n")
cat("- For example, soft drug use may have a different OR compared to hard drug use.\n")
cat("- Hard drug use often shows stronger associations with MDE than soft drugs.\n\n")

cat("### Notes:\n")
cat("- Analysis uses survey weights for national representativeness.\n")
cat("- Missing data handled via list-wise deletion (", original_rows - final_rows, " rows dropped).\n")
cat("- Consider multiple imputation for future robustness.\n")
```
